backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing user-scoped profiles, saving goals, emergency funds, and statistics with strict access control and validation logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature requirements to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains auto-generated summaries describing the purpose and behavior of each frontend source file.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global stylesheet defining OKLCH color tokens for light/dark themes and base UI styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML app entry point configuring PWA metadata, icons, and bootstrapping the main React script.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA manifest defining app metadata, icons, colors, and launch configuration.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker enabling install-time caching, cache cleanup, and network-first fetch handling with offline fallback.
frontend/SECURITY_DATA_ISOLATION_VERIFIC: Guide outlining manual steps to verify strict per-user data isolation across backend and UI states.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component handling authentication, profile setup flow, and rendering either onboarding or the dashboard with goal data.
A modal that displays app info, provides a shareable link, and includes actions for copying the URL or following on X.
frontend/src/components/CreateGoalForm.t: Form component for creating a new saving goal, including name, amounts, optional deadline, and submission to backend.
frontend/src/components/Dashboard.tsx: Displays user saving goals with stats, monthly target, next deadlines, and provides card or table views with a create-new button.
frontend/src/components/EditGoalDialog.t: Dialog allowing users to edit an existing saving goal’s details such as name, amounts, currency, and deadline.
frontend/src/components/EmergencyFundCar: Card showing emergency fund totals with visibility toggle and dialogs to adjust bank or cash amounts.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders a footer with branding, a heart icon, and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/GoalCard.tsx: Displays an interactive card for a saving goal with progress, editing, deleting, quick-add, deadline logic, and confetti for completion.
frontend/src/components/GoalTable.tsx: Renders a table listing saving goals with progress, deadline status, and actions for editing, deleting, and quick-adding savings.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Provides the app header with authentication controls, theme switching, currency selection, name editing, and access to modals.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal for initial user profile setup, letting users set their name and default currency.
Shows lifetime statistics stored in localStorage with reset capability and overview of achievements and totals.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on authentication state and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, handling identity loading, login flow, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and updating user profile data, theme preferences, and backend interactions with improved error handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS base styles with custom OKLCH color variables, dark mode overrides, and custom emerald utility classes.
frontend/src/lib/dateUtils.ts: Formats dates in either DD/MM/YYYY or MM/DD/YYYY based on the selected currency.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/registerSW.ts: Registers a service worker on page load and periodically checks for updates.
frontend/src/utils/monthlyTarget.ts: Calculates monthly savings targets for goals and totals using deadlines and progress logic.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, containers, animations, and plugin setup using CSS variable-driven OKLCH colors.
project_state.json: Describes the current dashboard project state and requirements to replace the first top-row card with a computed Monthly Target card. Includes architectural notes, existing features, and new feature requests related to styling, calculation logic, and layout constraints.
